title: Systems Engineer, EW

• Counter-RCIED

• Excellent at balancing multiple projects at any given time.

• Enthusiastic about both working with a team and executing work individually.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret/Top Secret security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with mission modeling tools like AFSIM and STK.

• Flight Test experience and flight test data analysis.

• Experience in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including the use of modelling tools (e.g. Cameo)
